agent.name: Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: Diffusion factors peer evidence and bounded timing implications

analytical_question: How far has the technology and application spread, and what does that imply for this organization?
general_et_finding: Generative AI has substantial but uneven workplace use. The May 2026 research observation shows growth over the earlier comparison period, not proof of an ongoing increase at every date. Broad survey evidence does not identify one universal Rogers stage.
application_finding: The complete screenshot-to-content-and-Canva workflow has no matched diffusion evidence in this packet. Relative advantage could be time savings; compatibility depends on the existing process; complexity involves technical review; trialability could support small tests; observability would involve seeing results.
organization_specific_finding: The hypothetical fast follower could gather comparable cases and consider a small internal learning exercise. Its actual adopter category is unestablished.

evidence.claim: Job-related generative AI use increased over the stated historical observations.
evidence.date_or_recency: Published September 2026; observation through May 2026; accessed 2026-10-26
evidence.notes: Workers are not businesses; exact application spread is unknown.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Broad AI uptake is not evidence of the complete workflow in textiles.
General use need not imply deep integration.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in broad diffusion signals; low confidence in matched application spread.
value_opportunity_implication: Learning could reduce uncertainty about workflow effort.
risk_governance_implication: Preserve final technical and publication review.
recommendation_management_implication: Consider limited learning and peer-evidence collection. Leave overall adoption to the Adoption Agent.
change_monitoring_triggers: Better evidence on effort and quality.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Need matched textile-workflow diffusion evidence and technical review capacity.
